title: I’m building an open-source persistent strategy game solo with GPT-5.6 Ultra
author: 0xAel
selftext:
I’m building Warpkeep, an open-source persistent browser strategy game connected to Farcaster. Heavily inspired by Hyperion Cantos Novel series but applied to a fantasy setting.

I’m working on it solo, and GPT-5.6 Ultra has generated the entire implementation so far. I wouldn’t be able to attempt a project like this alone without AI, so I’m fully embracing it in the workflow.

Repo:

[https://github.com/ael-dev3/Warpkeep](https://github.com/ael-dev3/Warpkeep)

The stack is React, TypeScript, Vite, Three.js/WebGL, SpacetimeDB, Cloudflare Workers, Farcaster Auth, and Vitest.

Persistent world state and Farcaster sign-in are working. The core gameplay loop is still unfinished. I’m building toward territory control, PvP, alliances, diplomacy, and political gameplay, with Farcaster identity and the social graph connecting players inside the world.

I’d love to grow the player base and let player feedback influence the direction. GPT models, SpacetimeDB, Farcaster, and browser graphics are all improving quickly, so I expect the game’s look and direction to change over time as well.

The repo contains all the code, documentation, tests, and public development history. Feedback on the game or the AI workflow is welcome.
